name: camayoc_adversarially_proven_checks
description: verification-and-liveness Q4: which checks were PROVEN adversarial — a deliberate sabotage shown to flip them — and which were only asserted to work. An unbound proof column is the assertion-only population; the query never fills one in.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?verification ?label ?provenBy WHERE { ?verification a aegis:Verification ; rdfs:label ?label . OPTIONAL { ?verification aegis:adversariallyProvenBy ?provenBy } } ORDER BY ?label
